versions.changelog:
**Major update with deeper, more visual analysis and stricter data standards:**

- Produces a rich, visually-structured HTML & markdown report, including summary cards, valuation tables, risk matrix, and inline charts (no external libraries).
- Now requires comparison across 6+ dimensions with concrete numbers and judgments, not just summaries.
- Adds explicit requirements for at least three charts (e.g., market share donut, revenue trend).
- Strengthens peer valuation comparison (P/E, PEG, P/S) and risk presentation (with probability/impact).
- Every figure must carry a dated source citation; increased emphasis on data depth and accuracy.
- Output must pass a detailed reporting checklist before delivery.
